'''2022 MPC Jason Riendeau LS OA''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jason Riendeau]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jason Riendeau]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
